name: Facebook Automation & SEO Studio
description: Pre-Trained Phone (Desktop-on-Phone www.facebook.com & Mobile Touch m.facebook.com) and Desktop Facebook Automation Engine (v1.8.4): Dedicated Feed Posts (Text/Photo/Carousel/Video), Anti-Comment Firewall (strictly never posts into comments), Reels (/reels/create + automatic mobile fallback + video event dispatch), Stories (/stories/create Photo/Video with overlay story_text & Text Story), Real Video/Reel Thumbnail & Cover Uploader, Multiline Formatted Caption Engine (Title + Description + Bullets + CTA + 3-6 #Hashtags), and Zero-Overthinking 1-Call Dispatch, and built-in DeepX Google Flow engine for AI thumbnails, Reel covers and post designs (login check → Agent/Standard question → autopilot, automatic Agent fallback on unusual-activity blocks).
author: Dipesh Kr Yadav

mcp_tools.name: fb_status
mcp_tools.description: Check Facebook Automation status, automatically open Facebook in the AntiGem browser if not open, and verify one-time login state. NOTE: Do NOT call fb_status before fb_publish—call fb_publish directly in 1 step! If logged_in is false (action_required='ONE_TIME_LOGIN_REQUIRED'), tell the user once to sign in to Facebook in the open AntiGem browser tab and STOP immediately.

open_browser.description: Automatically open Facebook in the AntiGem browser if no Facebook tab is currently open (default: true).

mcp_tools.name: fb_login_status
mcp_tools.description: Open Facebook (https://www.facebook.com/) in the AntiGem browser if not open, verify active login session (cookies + DOM), and persist one-time login state. IMPORTANT: If logged_in is false, Facebook is already open on the login screen in the AntiGem browser—ask the user once for their one-time login and STOP immediately (do not loop).

open_browser.description: Open and focus Facebook in the AntiGem browser if not already open (default: true).

mcp_tools.name: fb_open_browser
mcp_tools.description: Explicitly open and focus Facebook inside the AntiGem browser (feed, reels composer, story creator, or specific page/group) and check one-time login readiness.

view.description: Target Facebook section to open in the AntiGem browser (default: 'feed').

target_id.description: Optional Page ID, Group ID, or custom Facebook URL.

mcp_tools.name: fb_publish
mcp_tools.description: 1-STEP FEED PUBLISHER (Text, Photo, Carousel, Feed Video — also routes Reel/Story if post_type specifies). NOTE: Prefer `fb_publish_reel` for Facebook Reels and `fb_publish_story` for Facebook Stories! ALWAYS include `title`, formatted multiline `caption` (Title -> blank line -> Description/Quote -> Bullets -> CTA, keeping \n\n line breaks), and 3-6 `hashtags`. For Feed Videos (`post_type="video"`), pass `thumbnail_path` and it will be uploaded inside Edit Video -> Thumbnail (NEVER attached as a second feed photo). For Photos (`post_type="photo"`), combine `media_paths` + deep `caption` + `title` + 3-6 `hashtags` in ONE call.

title.description: Scroll-stopping viral Title / Headline for the post, photo, video, or reel (auto-crafted if omitted).

caption.description: Senior Social Media Manager caption combining a deep quote, 2-3 punchy micro-insights, and an engaging question CTA (auto-crafted if omitted or short).

hashtags.description: List of 3-6 targeted hashtags (e.g. ['#Mindset', '#Growth']). Automatically appended to the caption.

media_paths.description: List of file paths to photos or videos (supports /sdcard/..., ~/..., absolute paths, or ['latest'] to automatically attach the newest photo/video on the device).

thumbnail_path.description: Optional path (local or file:// URI) to custom JPG/PNG/WebP thumbnail for Feed Video (`post_type="video"`) or Reel. Uploaded via Edit Video -> Thumbnail / Reel Cover panel (never attached as extra feed photo). If missing for video/reel, ask user to provide one or generate via AI Image Model (`fb_thumbnail_prompt`).

post_type.description: Format of the Facebook upload: 'photo', 'carousel', 'video', 'reel', 'story', or 'text'. Always set 'photo' when uploading a photo!

target_type.description: Where to publish: 'profile' (personal feed), 'page' (managed page), or 'group'.

target_id.description: Optional Page ID/slug or Group ID.

first_comment.description: Optional first comment (e.g. external resource link) to post immediately after publishing.

story_text.description: Short overlay text (<=120 chars) used ONLY when post_type='story' (Stories have no caption/hashtag field).

mcp_tools.name: fb_publish_reel
mcp_tools.description: DEDICATED FACEBOOK REELS PUBLISHER (`https://www.facebook.com/reels/create` + automatic mobile Feed fallback). Use THIS tool whenever the user asks to post/upload a Facebook Reel! Supports `video_path` (local/file:///'latest'), custom cover `thumbnail_path` (applied in the Reel Cover/Thumbnail panel before Publish), `title`, formatted multiline `caption` description (`\n\n` spacing preserved), and 3-6 `hashtags`.

video_path.description: Path to the vertical MP4/MOV video file (supports /sdcard/..., ~/..., absolute paths, or 'latest').

caption.description: Reel caption body with hook, quote, and CTA.

hashtags.description: List of 3-6 targeted hashtags (auto-appended if not already in caption).

thumbnail_path.description: Custom JPG/PNG/WebP cover image uploaded in the Reel Edit/Cover panel. If not provided, ask the user whether to supply one or generate via AI Image Model (`fb_thumbnail_prompt`).

target_id.description: Optional Page ID if publishing to a page.

mcp_tools.name: fb_publish_story
mcp_tools.description: DEDICATED FACEBOOK STORIES PUBLISHER (`https://www.facebook.com/stories/create`). Use THIS tool whenever the user asks to upload a Photo Story, Video Story, or Text Story! Supports `media_path` (image/video or 'latest'; omit for a Text Story) and optional short `story_text` overlay (clicked into 'Add text' -> 'Done', <=120 chars). Note: Stories do NOT have feed captions or hashtags.

media_path.description: Local or file:// path (or 'latest') to photo/video for Photo/Video Story. Omit to publish a Text Story.

story_text.description: Short overlay text (Photo/Video Story 'Add text') or full message for Text Story. Max 120 chars for media overlay.

caption.description: Legacy fallback text if `story_text` is omitted (first line used; Stories do not support feed captions or hashtags).

mcp_tools.name: fb_thumbnail_prompt
mcp_tools.description: Craft an ultra-detailed, creative Master Art Direction prompt for generating a high-CTR clickbait thumbnail using an AI Image Model (Nano Banana Pro / Google Flow / image-generator subagent). STRICT MANDATE: NEVER use Python (PIL/Pillow/OpenCV) to generate thumbnails! Always pass this tool's prompt to the AI Image Model to render the thumbnail. Then generate the image with deepx_generate in THIS plugin (Google login check → ask Agent Mode or Standard → download:true) and pass files[0].path as thumbnail_path.

topic.description: Core topic or subject of the video/reel/post.

title_hook.description: Dominant 2-4 word bold hook text to render in the thumbnail (e.g. 'STOP DOING THIS', 'SECRET REVEALED').

subtitle.description: Short 3-6 word subtitle badge text explaining what it is about.

archetype.description: Creative visual archetype for the AI Image Model (default: 'surreal_metaphor').

aspect_ratio.description: Thumbnail aspect ratio: '9:16' for Reels/Stories, '16:9' for landscape video, '4:5' for feed portrait.

mcp_tools.name: fb_resume_pending
mcp_tools.description: Resume and execute any pending Facebook upload task (post, reel, story, edit, delete, comment) after the user has completed their one-time login in the AntiGem browser.

mcp_tools.name: fb_schedule
mcp_tools.description: Schedule a Facebook post, carousel, video, reel, or story for future publication. Enforces Title + formatted multiline Description + 3-6 #Hashtags for feed/video/reel posts, or clean `story_text` for Stories.

run_at_timestamp.description: Unix epoch timestamp (seconds) or ISO time when the post should publish.

media_paths.description: List of file paths to media (or ['latest']).

thumbnail_path.description: Optional path to AI-Image-Model-generated or custom thumbnail.

target_id.description: Optional target Page or Group ID.

mcp_tools.name: fb_edit_post
mcp_tools.description: Re-edit an existing Facebook post caption via 3-dots DOM menu automation in the AntiGem browser.

post_url_or_id.description: URL or identifier of the post to edit (or 'latest' for the most recent post on profile).

new_caption.description: New caption text to replace the existing post content.

mcp_tools.name: fb_delete_post
mcp_tools.description: Delete a Facebook post or move it to trash via 3-dots menu automation in the AntiGem browser.

post_url_or_id.description: URL or identifier of the post to delete (or 'latest' for the most recent post).

mcp_tools.name: fb_list_posts
mcp_tools.description: List published, scheduled, awaiting-login, or failed posts from local storage and database.

mcp_tools.name: fb_seo_generate
mcp_tools.description: Generate a complete algorithm-optimized viral Facebook package: Title, 1-line Hook, Deep Quote, 3-4 punchy Micro-Bullets, Engagement CTA, 3-6 targeted Hashtags, Alt-Text, First-Comment Link, AND a detailed AI Image Model Thumbnail Prompt.

topic.description: Core subject or idea of the post.

link_url.description: Optional outbound link to place in first comment.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio for the AI Image Model thumbnail prompt (default: '9:16' for Reels, '16:9' for Video).

mcp_tools.name: fb_audit_caption
mcp_tools.description: Audit a post caption for Facebook algorithmic penalties (missing title/hook, missing hashtags, outbound links in body, hashtag stuffing, wall-of-text density).

mcp_tools.name: fb_comments
mcp_tools.description: Post a comment (e.g. first comment with external link) or reply on a Facebook post in the AntiGem browser.

post_url_or_id.description: URL or identifier of the target post (or 'latest' for active post).

mcp_tools.name: fb_doctor
mcp_tools.description: Self-diagnose Facebook automation environment, AntiGem browser tab state, one-time login persistence, debugger readiness, and anti-duplicate guardrails.

mcp_tools.name: deepx_generate
mcp_tools.description: AI images/videos for Facebook (thumbnails, Reel covers, post designs, short clips) through the built-in DeepX Google Flow engine. Checks the Google Flow login first (LOGIN_REQUIRED → tell the user to sign in, stop). If generation_mode is missing it returns ASK_GENERATION_MODE: ask 'Agent Mode or Standard mode (without Agent)?' and call again. Pass download:true and use files[0].path from deepx_job_status as thumbnail_path/media_paths. Standard mode auto-switches to Agent Mode on Google 'unusual activity' blocks; Agent Mode sends ≤24 prompts per part back-to-back. Never ask the user to generate in Google Flow manually.

generation_mode.description: REQUIRED answer from the user: 'agent' (Google Flow Agent Mode) or 'standard' (without Agent). Never guess: if the user has not chosen for this request, omit it and the tool returns ASK_GENERATION_MODE so you can ask.

media_type.description: 'image' or 'video'. Pass it explicitly when known.

prompt.description: One prompt, or a bulk request like '100 images of vintage cars' / '1 to 500 number designs' (auto-expanded).

prompts.description: List of prompts, one output item each (any length; Agent Mode splits into parts of ≤24, Standard mode accepts ≤500).

script_text.description: Storyboard/script; scenes separated by blank lines (or numbered lines). Use auto_breakdown for raw stories.

auto_breakdown.description: Analyze a raw story into scenes with @handles before generating.

model.description: Model shortcut for the media type (e.g. 'Nano Banana 2.1', 'Nano Banana Pro', 'Omni Flash 1.2', 'Veo 3.1 - Quality').

image_model.description: Image model (Agent: Nano Banana 2.1/Pro/2 Lite/Imagen 3; Standard: Nano Banana 2.1/Pro/2 Lite).

video_model.description: Video model (Agent: Omni Flash 1.2/Omni 1.1 Flash/Veo 3.1 Quality/Fast/Lite; Standard: Omni 1.1 Flash/Veo 3.1 Lite/Fast/Quality).

references.description: Standard mode: reference media IDs, @handles or local image paths.

max_per_part.description: Agent Mode items per pasted part (max 24, default 24).

total_count.description: Explicit total for a single subject prompt (e.g. 100).

custom_instructions.description: Agent Mode: persistent custom instructions to sync before pasting (defaults to DeepX Master Autopilot Director).

style_lock.description: Shared style sentence appended to every Agent part for consistency.

auto_fallback.description: Standard mode: switch to Agent Mode automatically when Google shows an unusual-activity / extension / captcha block (default true).

autopilot.description: Agent Mode: auto-approve credit cards and answer Flow Agent questions (default true).

download.description: Agent Mode: download new media to ~/flow-media when finished.

new_project.description: Standard mode: create a new project first.

part_timeout_sec.description: Agent Mode: max seconds to wait for one part before sending the next (default 480 image / 900 video).

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before returning (0–45). Poll deepx_job_status afterwards.

dry_run.description: Standard mode: prepare and guard-block the request without spending credits.

download_concurrency.description: Parallel downloads per part (default 8). Each part downloads while the next part generates.

mcp_tools.name: deepx_job_status
mcp_tools.description: Poll any DeepX job (Agent Mode queue, standard batch, auto-fallback) by job_id. Waits up to wait_seconds (default 30, max 50) for completion. Shows parts done, stage, media_ids and fallback_job when standard mode was switched to Agent Mode.

job_id.description: Job id from deepx_generate or another tool.

mcp_tools.name: deepx_check_login
mcp_tools.description: Check that a Google account is signed in to Google Flow in the AntiGem browser (opens Flow if needed). If not signed in it returns LOGIN_REQUIRED with one message to tell the user; otherwise continue with the task.

mcp_tools.name: deepx_status
mcp_tools.description: One-call readiness check: Google Flow tab, sign-in, project, Agent pill state, running jobs and whether standard mode was recently blocked. Opens Flow in the AntiGem browser if needed. Call at most once per session; never before deepx_generate.

mcp_tools.name: deepx_cancel_job
mcp_tools.description: Cancel a DeepX job (Agent Mode queue or standard batch) and its children. Omit job_id to cancel everything running.

mcp_tools.name: deepx_get_options
mcp_tools.description: DeepX knowledge: all Flow models, modes, ratios, durations, @handle referencing, prompt cinematography and the Agent vs Standard mode table.

mcp_tools.name: deepx_flow_agent_status
mcp_tools.description: Google Flow Agent Mode pill status on the current canvas (found / active / busy).

mcp_tools.name: deepx_flow_agent_toggle
mcp_tools.description: Turn Google Flow Agent Mode on or off (omit active to toggle).

mcp_tools.name: deepx_flow_agent_configure
mcp_tools.description: Configure Flow Agent settings: 100% autopilot ('Confirm before generating: Never'), default video/image model, aspect ratio, quality.

autopilot.description: Set Confirm before generating: Never (default true).

media_type.description: 'image' or 'video'. Pass it explicitly when known.

mcp_tools.name: deepx_flow_agent_set_instructions
mcp_tools.description: Write persistent custom instructions into Flow Agent (article_spark panel) for style/character consistency.

instructions_text.description: Instructions text (default: DeepX Master Autopilot Director).

mcp_tools.name: deepx_flow_agent_approve_all
mcp_tools.description: Approve any pending Flow Agent credit card ('Always approve in project' / 'Approve') and answer a pending Agent question.

keywords.description: Topic words to pick the matching choice.

mcp_tools.name: deepx_flow_agent_batch_queue
mcp_tools.description: Agent Mode bulk queue for 1–5000 items (ranges like 1 to 1000, '100 images of X', or long prompt lists): ≤24 items per part, back-to-back, autopilot approvals. Returns a job.

prompt_or_storyboard.description: Bulk request ('100 images of cyber cars', '1 to 1000 numbers') or multi-item storyboard text (blank-line separated).

prompts.description: Explicit prompt list (split into parts of ≤24).

media_type.description: 'image' or 'video'. Pass it explicitly when known.

custom_instructions.description: Instructions to sync into Flow Agent first.

character_names.description: Character @handles to keep in every item.

download_concurrency.description: Parallel downloads per part (default 8). Each part downloads while the next part generates.

mcp_tools.name: deepx_upscale_media
mcp_tools.description: Upscale a Flow image (2K/4K) or video (1080p/4K). Omit media_id to upscale the latest media.

mcp_tools.name: deepx_download_media
mcp_tools.description: Chrome Flow MCP compatibility alias for flow_download_media. Download media by ID, a list of IDs (media_ids — parallel, ordered names) or URL into local terminal storage, with an optional filename and folder.

url.description: Direct FifeURL or download redirect URL of the media.

media_ids.description: Bulk download (v1.2.4): many media IDs at once, downloaded in parallel (8 at a time) and saved with ordered names 001_, 002_ … in this exact order. Use this instead of one call per image.

start_index.description: Number offset for ordered names (e.g. 24 -> first file is 025_).

prefix.description: Optional name part after the number, e.g. 'quote' -> 001_quote_<id>.jpg.

type.description: Media type hint; skips a lookup per file.

mcp_tools.name: deepx_upload_asset
mcp_tools.description: Chrome Flow MCP compatibility alias for flow_upload_media. Upload local image/video files into a Flow project (through Flow's own upload, so they appear in the project). Returns their new media ids, usable as references or frames. Not needed before flow_generate_*: those accept local paths directly.

file_path.description: Absolute local path to the image or video file.

mcp_tools.name: flow_get_last_media
mcp_tools.description: Get the newest images or videos ("the last image", "the previous 2 videos"): first the results of this session's tools, then the newest items of the project. Use the returned media_id with other flow_* tools.

project_id.description: Project to look in (default: the open project)

mcp_tools.name: flow_get_media
mcp_tools.description: Get a Flow image or video as a local file (saved once in ~/flow-media; later calls reuse the same file, never copy it). Set view=true to also receive an image inline so you can look at it. To show it in chat, write ![caption](<path>) on its own line.

view.description: Also return the image inline for viewing (images only, default false)

mcp_tools.name: flow_list_media
mcp_tools.description: List images and videos in a Flow project (mediaId, type, title, prompt, size, pending). Optional query filters by title/prompt (like Flow's search box); pending_only lists videos still generating. cached_path is set when the file is already saved locally; use flow_get_media to fetch one.

project_id.description: Project ID (default: the project open in the Flow tab)

query.description: Optional case-insensitive text to search in titles and prompts

include_trashed.description: Also list media in Flow's trash (default false)
